name: Communications Evidence
purpose: Define read-only local PST/OST source processing, canonical message identity, operational links, proposals, coverage, background processing, terminal unlink/orphan purge and communication summaries without acquiring owning-domain lifecycle authority.

decisions.decision: Communication Source Scope, canonical Communication identity, entity links, domain proposals, MSG drafts, background jobs and orphan housekeeping are distinct authorities and never implicit cross-writes.
Beta 1.0 communication ingestion is local/read-only PST/OST processing only; SOMA does not connect to mail services or mutate external stores.
Automatic processing is target-gated by a versioned registry of accepted operational identities; descriptive/master/reference data alone is not trackable identity.
Canonical message identity is immutable and scoped to one Source Scope; provider-stable identity is preferred and deterministic versioned fallback identity is used only when required.
Only matched/protected communications persist as reconstructable content; one canonical message can hold independently addressable links to many governed entities.
Communication-derived domain facts are proposals only. Owning-domain commands perform every accepted SR/RFC/Inventory/Objectives mutation after fresh validation.
RFC direct Communication unlink occurs only after separately confirmed local terminal cascade, never merely from provider terminal evidence/import acceptance.

After the final protected dependency is removed, reconstructable content enters a default seven-exact-day orphan grace; due purge revalidates dependencies transactionally and preserves only non-reconstructable minimized evidence.
Forward coverage/high-water, targeted backfill and explicit Deep Scan are separate operations; unknown source chronology remains unknown and no job may claim unprocessed coverage.
Communication Processing uses one coalesced per-scope pipeline and durable background jobs; orphan housekeeping is a separate idempotent scheduler.
Generated MSG draft identity is distinct from a later observed sent Communication; artifact generation/export never proves sending.
Workbench communication summaries are projections of canonical links/coverage; terminal summaries freeze minimized counts/chronology before governed unlink and never preserve hidden message bodies.

unresolved_here_by_design: exact PST/OST/MSG parsing library and supported subset
exact Source Scope provider-origin identity fields
exact durable job/checkpoint tables and retry limits
exact search-index implementation for retained communication content
